facts.fact: 写笑话的方法和写笑话的人一样多；有时笑话会完整地出现在脑中，有时靠偶然听错，但有时必须下功夫
facts.anchor: As with anything creative, there are as many ways of writing a joke as there are people doing it.

facts.fact: 写“愉快地烂”的笑话有个办法：倒着来（work backwards）
facts.anchor: One way of writing cheerfully bad gags is to work backwards.

facts.fact: 第一步“You massive idiom”：从一个听众都熟的短语、习语、电影名开始，例 Everything must go / To be or not to be / Back to the Future / The Cold War
facts.anchor: Start off with a phrase, an idiom, a movie title or something else well-known enough that your audience will know what it is.

facts.fact: 第二步 Smash it up：拆音节，想押韵、同音异义词、同形同音异义词、spoonerisms（互换辅音，如 a pair of shoes → a share of poos）
facts.anchor: Think of rhymes, homophones (words that mean different things but sound the same), homonyms

facts.fact: 第三步 Abandon most of them：概率不利，多数硬造出来的属于“烂到真的糟”那一类
facts.anchor: Numbers aren’t on your side. There are jokes that are so bad they’re good, and jokes that are so bad they’re really, really terrible.

facts.fact: 反例：都铎与斯图亚特王朝为“谁鼻孔更好看”开战？Phwoar of the Noses 谐音 War of the Roses——作者自己说“Doubt it!”
facts.anchor: Did the Tudors and Stuarts battle over who had the most attractive nostrils in the Phwoar of the Noses? Doubt it!

facts.fact: 第四步 Get reverse engineering：倒推铺垫，最好不用包袱里的关键词；可用 what do you get when you cross an X with a Y 等固定问句
facts.anchor: Now build out a setup, ideally not using any of the key words from the punchline.

facts.fact: 著名的包袱 Super calloused fragile mystic vexed by halitosis（谐音 Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious）可以用很多种铺垫抵达
facts.anchor: There’s a fairly well-known punchline, ‘Super calloused fragile mystic vexed by halitosis’, which can be reached in a lot of ways.

facts.fact: 第五步自问：听众会不会根本听不懂？你全程在场，但要站在第一次听的人的角度
facts.anchor: Think about whether your joke is just confusing. You’ve been there for the whole process, but put yourself in the shoes of someone hearing it for the first time.

facts.fact: 反例：农场主最爱的八十年代动作片 The Germinator——germinate 不常用，germ 与 German 常用，作者判定“not a joke as much as a noise”，建议扔掉重来
facts.anchor: What’s a farmer’s favourite 1980s action film? The Germinator!

facts.fact: 第六步 Enjoy the groans：终于写出一条勉强能用的？很好，再写一百条
facts.anchor: Have you finally come up with one that just about works? Well done! Now write another hundred!
